title: US Panic: $1.2 Trillion Wiped Out in a Day as China Dumps $27.3B in US Debt
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: Official normalised-flow figures are suspect; Brent ~113, insurance costs and a diesel refining shortage keep energy prices high and could push them higher.
AI companies face a consumption problem; the Anthropic IPO looks like a cashout; the sell-off may not be over.
China's Treasury selling is policy, not a trade; its gold buying will keep rising, shifting power East.

calls.reason: Converging crises (oil inflation, AI earnings fears, China competition) mean the tech sell-off may continue unless the war ends.
calls.quote: So this sell-off may not be over yet. The only real way to reverse it is to end the war

calls.reason: Supply disruption, rising shipping insurance, refining shortage and winter mean prices stay high and may go much higher.
calls.quote: So, don't expect a sudden drop in energy prices. In fact, prices might go much higher

calls.reason: China swapping Treasuries for gold, buying 20+ tons/month and likely more off the books; money flowing to gold.
calls.quote: So, we should follow the flow of money. And right now, it's heading massively to gold.

notes: Brent price quoted (ticker normalised to CL). No specific targets given.
